free_tier.stated: Free models cost $0 including inference fees (anonrouter/free or an exact :free ID); the standard account allowance is 20 requests per minute, 100,000 reserved tokens per minute and 2 concurrent free requests.

record.tooling: an OpenAI-compatible inference key with free models enabled on the account
record.chaining: the verified-email eligibility gate and the shared per-account free allowance are the scarce links

limits.value: 20 requests per minute, 100,000 reserved tokens per minute, 2 concurrent free requests per account

identity_cost.detail: free models require a verified, non-disposable email (or a credited purchase) and an account opt-in to Anonymous routes

record.reliability_note: free capacity is shared and can return 429 before the stated allowance; no paid fallback

evidence.proved: free models cost $0 with a stated per-account free allowance
evidence.quote: The standard account allowance is 20 requests per minute, 100,000 reserved tokens per minute, and 2 concurrent free requests, shared across its keys and free models.
